knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The original record is kept and shown, and the dispute is recorded and sent for decision. Silent changes are not permitted.
Only confirmed numbers are shown. The rest are left out until checked against the authority.
A dated amendment keeps the audit trail, and the original stays on file.
The privacy and customer details section says to limit access to people who need it, and to store records securely.

practicalCriteria: Invoice shows the required details, and any field without a source is left blank
Invoice is linked to its visit record and agreement by job number
A correction is made as a dated amendment, with the original kept
Customer access details are stored and shared only as the procedure states
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Sample client file with agreement, visit records and invoices
stopWorkCriteria: Licence or registration number shown as held before it is confirmed
Visit record changed without a dated amendment
Customer access details shared outside the service
